verses.text: Ix yalanxi Jehová t'a winhaj Moisés chi' icha tik:
Al jun cheknab'il tik t'a heb' etchonhab' chi': Ha t'a stiempoal chekel yajkani, sk'anab'ajej heb' yak'an juntzanh ofrenda snhusjitz'a silab'il t'ayin, te suk'uk'i sjab' swab'i, xchi t'a winh.

Ix yalan winhaj Moisés chi' t'a heb' yetchonhab' chi' yuj juntzanh ofrenda yowalil snhustz'a heb' yuj yik'jicha'anh Jehová. Junjun k'u snhusjitz'a chatakwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail. Jun nok' snhusjitz'a t'a k'inhib'alil, haxo junxo nok' t'a yemk'uhalil. Yowalil tz'ak'ji chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach', skalaj yet' junok litro aceite yik sat te' olivo ofrendail yet' junjun nok'. Tz'ak'jipax junjun litro wino yet' junjun nok' kalnel chi', sekchajem b'aj ay skajnub' Jehová yuj yik'jicha'anh. Ha t'a lum witzal Sinaí ix schek Jehová ak'jok juntzanh silab' tik t'a junjun k'u, haton ofrenda suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová.

Ha t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, yowalil syak' chawanhokxo nok' kelemtak kalnel heb', haton nok' jun ab'il sk'inal, malaj jab'ok spaltail yet' wajxake' libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite t'a ofrendail t'a ixim trigo. Tz'ak'jipax wino yet'ok, ichataxon tz'aj yak'ji.
Masanil juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji t'a sk'uhal ik'oj ip, palta ch'ok yel t'a yichanh silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.

Ha t'a b'ab'el k'uhal yik junjun uj tzeyak' chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax silab'il yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil nok' tik, mokab'a jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' junjun nok' wakax chi' tzeyak' lajchaweok libra ixim harina te wach', tze kalan yet' aceite. Haxo yet' nok' ch'ak kalnel chi' tzeyak' wajxakeok libra ixim harina te wach', kalab'il yet' aceite.
Haxo yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi', chanhe' libra ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite tzeyak'a'. Haton jun ofrenda snhusjitz'a chi', suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová.

Haxo wino tz'ak'jitaxon t'a ofrendail, chab' litro tz'ak'ji yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', nanhal schab'il litro t'a jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi', junjun litro t'a junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'. Haton juntzanh ofrenda chi' yowalil tz'ak'ji t'a junjun uj t'a yol ab'il.
Ha yet' silab' snhusjitz'a chi', tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa t'a Jehová silab'il yuj mul yet' wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.
T'a 14 yoch b'ab'el uj t'a yol ab'il, hata' tz'och k'inh yik tze na'ankoti ayik eyelnak libre yuj Jehová.
Haxo t'a 15 yoch uj chi', hata' tz'och uke' k'uhal k'inh, haton ta' swaji ixim pan malaj yich.
Ha t'a b'ab'el k'u t'a uke' k'uhal chi' tz'och jun niwan molanil yuj eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.
Chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax tz'ak'ji silab'il, jun nok' ch'ak kalnel yet' ukwanh nok' kelemtak kalnel junjun ab'il sk'inal. Masanil nok' chi', malajokab' jab'ok spaltail nok'.

Ha yet' juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'ji juntzanhxo ofrenda tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok, ixim harina kalab'il yet' aceite, tz'ak'ji icha tik: Lajchawe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tz'ak'jipax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj mul yik stupkanel he mul t'a eyib'anh.
Masanil juntzanh chi' tz'ak'ji yet' jun silab' snhusjitz'a t'a k'inhib'alil t'a junjun k'u.

Icha chi' tz'aj t'a junjun k'u t'a uke' k'uhal k'inh chi'. Snhusjitz'a juntzanh ofrenda chi', suk'uk'i sjab' syab' Jehová. Palta ch'ok pax yaj silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u yet' pax wino tz'ak'jitaxon yet'ok.
Haxo t'a yukil k'uhal, tz'ochpax junxo niwan molanil yuj eyoch ejmelal. Ha t'a jun k'u chi', malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.

Ayik toxo ix ek'b'at uke' semana yek' k'inh yik tze na'ankot eyelnak libre yuj Jehová, tzeyak'an eyofrenda yuj sb'ab'el sat eyawb'en tze molo'. Tze molb'ej he b'a he masanil yuj eyoch ejmelal t'a Jehová, malaj junok makan munlajel tze k'ulej.
Tzeyak'pax junok silab' te wach' t'a Jehová suk'uk'i sjab' syab'i: Chawanh nok' kelemtak wakax, junok nok' ch'ak kalnel, ukwanhok nok' kelemtak kalnel jun ab'il sk'inal,
yet' ixim harina te wach' kalab'il yet' aceite tz'ak'jitaxoni, lajchawe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' wakax chi', wajxake' libra ixim yet' jun nok' ch'ak kalnel chi',
chanhe' libra ixim yet' junjun nok' kelemtak kalnel chi'.
Tzeyak'anpax junok nok' mam chiwa silab'il yuj he mul.
Ha yet' juntzanh silab' chi' tz'ak'jinhej ofrenda t'a ixim harina yet' wino. Tzeyak'anpax silab' tz'ak'jitaxon t'a junjun k'u. Masanil nok' tz'ak'ji chi', yowalil malaj jab'ok spaltail nok'.
